_schema: qec_twin.code_status.v1 — hand-maintained status overlay for tools/gen_code_map.py. Keys = package paths relative to src/qec_twin (or a module path for a per-module override). status in {ACTIVE, PLACEHOLDER, ARCHIVED, TOOLING}. gen_code_map.py DRIFT-CHECKS this against the code: add an entry when a new package appears, remove one when a package is deleted (both are flagged in CODE_MAP.md's DRIFT CHECK).

note: package root — numerics.NUMERICAL_ZERO floor + package glue

audit.note: evaluator-side gating (identifiability) / bands (uncertainty) / validity (curve) + bayes_floor decoding-floor oracle + certify

audit/certify.note: the carrier<->DM certification seam: {det,obs} record schema, Anchor/Control independent-GT ports, ControlledTeacher protocol, scoring (certify_cells)

audit/certify/anchors.note: independent-ground-truth anchor ports (DM-oracle / stim-slice / closed-form); anti-circular referees

calibration.note: [RECOVER] label-free exact Born-NLL calibration; consumes observations ONLY (isolation contract)

decoder.note: frozen-MWPM DEM substrate (evaluator-side; DEM/decoder/LER stays OUT of the validity chain — feedback-simulator-not-decoder)

forward.note: exact differentiable forward: cptp_channel + channels + window_channel + joint_lindbladian (Axis-1 within-substep assembler, G2-certified)

forward/exact.note: density-matrix backend — FEASIBILITY-ONLY (<=~15q); the 50+q target is forward/scalable

forward/kernels.note: fused CUDA subsystem-Kraus kernels; auto-routed on cuda tensors, CPU fallback, QEC_TWIN_NO_KERNELS=1 disables

forward/scalable.note: the 50+q CARRIER (no longer a placeholder): C1 composed (DEM/HMM bulk + window-exact CPTP + declared seam) + non-Pauli leakage MCWF-on-MPS; ADR 0008/0010

hardware.note: R2-lite real-Google ingestion + M1-M4 drivers; observations-only isolation; needs QEC_TWIN_HW_DATA=/home/cx/Document

knobs.note: [MANIPULATE] channel-level do() -> DeltaLER (parameterization-independent transforms, scored under a frozen decoder)

mechanisms.note: mechanism defs + controlled teachers: catalog, axis1_primitives, source_coupling/source_process (Axis-2 memory-ful source + Theta fan-out), coupled_teachers (CoupledCycleTeacher, 2026-07-03), qutrit/seam teachers

rag.note: hybrid vector-keyword store over the docs/papers reading notes (NoteStore, build_index, query); infrastructure, NOT twin logic

simulator.note: user-facing frontend: CircuitIR/CodeSpec/XZZX compiler, Stim import, sealed SubstepSchedule, .b8 record sampling; + the axis1 carrier-execution paths (dense joint-L probe / MCWF-MPS / QT-MPS / qutip-cuquantum) and the axis1_record_evidence dense {det,obs} emitter
